title: Understanding Variable Types
text: Think about what kind of data the 'price' column represents. Is it something that can take any value within a range, or is it limited to specific values?

title: Continuous vs. Discrete
text: Consider whether the 'price' can have decimal values or if it is restricted to whole numbers. This will help you determine if it's continuous or discrete.
